per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null because it is the primary join key for the table.
All S_N values must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty.
Account_No must be a four‑digit string (e.g., "1026").
If a name contains the male particle "Bin" (case‑insensitive) the Gender must be Male; if it contains any female particle ("Binte", "d/o", "s/o") the Gender must be Female.
ID_No must follow the pattern: one uppercase letter, seven digits, one uppercase letter (e.g., "S8403757E").
Race must be one of the canonical categories: Chinese, Malay, Indian.
Age must be between 13 and 120 inclusive.
Age must be parseable as a numeric value; non‑numeric entries are violations.
Contact_No must not be null because it is required for customer outreach.
Contact_No must match the Singapore international format "+65 XXXXXXXXX" where X is a digit (e.g., "+65 80734991").
Email must match the simple email pattern "^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+$" (i.e., contain a single @ and no whitespace).
Country must be the canonical value "Singapore".
Postal_Code must be a numeric string of length 4 to 6 digits (e.g., "12345").
Every S_N value must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N (one‑to‑one relationship).
Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
